latestVersion.changelog:
YouTube AI Video Maker v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill: turn raw video clips into polished, YouTube-ready videos using AI.
- Supports uploading video files (up to 500MB, major formats) and simple text prompts to drive editing.
- Automated intro, cuts, music, and export to 1080p MP4; fast turnaround (1–2 minutes for short clips).
- Handles session management, upload, credits, exports, and error states with cloud rendering.
- Streamlined for YouTubers who want rapid, professional results without complex editing software.
